_about.purpose: Phase 11 evaluation query set. SILVER (provisional) labels — authored by the project, not yet expert-validated. Numbers computed against it must be reported as preliminary until Dr. Sunita T. Pandey / the expert gold-set replaces or ratifies these labels.
_about.labelling: Two levels. BOOK level (available now): `relevant_books` marks which treatise(s) plausibly address the condition — supports Precision@k, nDCG, MRR, Hit@k. PASSAGE level (added later): `relevant_chunk_ids`, once populated, additionally makes Recall@k well-defined, since only then is the true number of relevant passages known.
_about.query_style: Queries are SYMPTOM-led, not crop-led, because the classical texts are general and symptom-based rather than crop-indexed. The crop is recorded separately as context only.

queries.query: dark rough corky lesions and scabby patches spreading over the leaves of a tree
orange to brown powdery pustules raised on the surface of tree leaves
rust-coloured powdery eruptions scattered along the leaf blade
long brown withering patches spreading and drying the leaves
greyish rectangular dead spots forming between the veins of the leaf
dark brown spots with concentric rings appearing first on the older lower leaves
rapidly spreading water-soaked blackening patches rotting the leaves in damp weather
ringed brown lesions enlarging on the leaves and causing them to fall
dark decaying blotches with pale mould at the leaf margins during wet weather
numerous small dark spots with pale centres covering the leaves
small greasy dark specks on leaves that later dry and tear
fuzzy discoloured mould growing on the underside of the leaves
mottled light and dark green patches with puckering and curling of the leaves
leaves turning yellow, cupping upward and the plant remaining stunted

queries.disease: Tomato two spotted spider mites leaf
queries.query: fine pale stippling and bronzing of leaves with tiny mites and webbing beneath
dark sunken spots scattered across the leaves that later dry out
white powdery coating spreading over the surface of the leaves
dark sunken decaying areas on leaves and shrivelling of the fruit on a climbing vine
a tree that is weak and poorly nourished with pale drooping foliage in exhausted soil
insects boring into the trunk and eating the leaves of a tree
preparing and enriching the soil before planting a young sapling
signs that foretell the coming of rain and the right time for sowing
the exact nitrogen phosphorus and potassium percentages required in the soil, expressed numerically
queries.note: Deliberate negative: modern quantitative agronomy is absent from the classical texts. The system should REFUSE rather than fabricate.

queries.query: which synthetic fungicide spray and dosage in millilitres per litre should be applied
queries.note: Deliberate negative: modern agrochemicals are outside the corpus; an honest refusal is the correct behaviour.
